# Remote Work Policy — v3

**Effective Date:** March 1, 2024
**Owner:** HR Department

---

## 1. Eligibility

All full-time employees who have completed their **90-day** probationary period are
eligible for remote work arrangements.

## 2. Work Hours

Employees must be available during **core hours: 10 AM – 4 PM** in their local time zone.
Outside of core hours, flexible scheduling is permitted.

## 3. Equipment Allowance

The company provides a one-time equipment stipend of **$800** for home office setup.
Receipts must be submitted within **90 days** of the allowance approval.

## 4. Internet Reimbursement

Employees are eligible for internet cost reimbursement of up to **$75 per month**.
Claims must be submitted monthly via the expense portal.

## 5. Performance Review

Remote work eligibility is subject to satisfactory performance reviews. Employees
receiving a "below expectations" rating will be required to return to office.

## 6. Security Requirements

All remote employees must:
- Use company-approved VPN at all times when accessing company systems
- Encrypt their hard drive using company-provided tools
- Complete the annual security certification

## 7. Co-Working Stipend

Employees may claim up to **$150 per month** for co-working space costs. Receipts
required.

## 8. Policy Review

This policy will be reviewed **semi-annually** in June and December.
